title: feat(nm2ocyccrdy): neighbor-read of cyclic lex-smallest Orient at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: opposite y-probes, neighbour-read of the cyclic lex-smallest orientation. Holds at A and C, fails at B and D - identical bits to the lex-largest wrapper (#7466), so the neighbour-read collapse on the y-probes is tie-break invariant.
